metadata.purpose: Ep. 14 of the AI in Astronomy & Space Science series, from weekly_stem_videos/ideas.md Astronomy topic 14 (Star classification & spectra - AI reading stellar spectra to determine composition/age/distance faster than manual analysis). The episode takes COMPOSITION, because that is where the label-inheritance problem is cleanest and best documented; distance would need a second, unrelated mechanism.
metadata.color_semantics: Claude fidelity palette. Terracotta #D97757 is the ONE accent and marks WHAT THE LABELS BROUGHT WITH THEM - the physics model in the chain, the error against truth, the inherited trend, the biased training set. Ink marks WHAT THE MODEL ITSELF DOES WELL - its agreement with its own labels, its repeat-measurement precision, and the anchored run that escapes the inheritance. The mapping never flips, so B05 teaches it once. Accented text is #A44A32; #B9B4A0 is strokes and fills only.
metadata.distinct_from_earlier_episodes: Eps. 01-06 had AI inspecting observations; 07 standing in for a calculation; 08 a division of labour; 09 an output that was never a measurement; 10 a training set produced by past decisions; 11 an objective that omitted the failure; 12 an evaluation inflated by the split; 13 a positive class that does not exist. Ep. 14 is the first where THE LABELS THEMSELVES ARE A MODEL'S OUTPUT. The data is real, the method is sound, the evaluation is honest, and the answer is still wrong - because 'ground truth' was never measured, it was computed. The limit is inherited rather than introduced, and it is invisible to every check performed against the same labels.
metadata.note: ILLUSTRATE LAW: the Claude UI appears at B00, B11, B12, B13. Every other beat illustrates its concept as a reel-local Manim scene (scenes.py). Plates come from assets/gen_stars.py, which runs the REAL algorithm - a quadratic data-driven model fitted per wavelength pixel and inverted at test time, exactly the published form - trained on labels from a physics pipeline carrying a deliberate temperature-dependent bias. THREE claims are ASSERTED and the script writes nothing if any fails. Seed 1414. B07 TRANSFORMS B06's scatter in place rather than presenting a second scatter plot, so the two beats do not read as consecutive slides. PUBLISHED (Ness et al. 2015; the SDSS DR14 documentation, which states the inheritance and the precision-is-not-accuracy point in the survey's own words) and COMPUTED-HERE are kept apart on screen and in the voice. No LaTeX/MathTex anywhere. metadata.channel_title is omitted for the GATE V edge-bleed reason logged in Ep. 03. scenes.py is ASPECT-AWARE.
